GOOD TO KNOW

A few quick
answers.

Where do you work? +

We serve New Bedford, Massachusetts and surrounding areas. Include your property address so we can confirm coverage.

Do you offer regular mowing? +

Yes. Ask about weekly and biweekly upkeep in your quote request.

How do I find out the price? +

Share the services, property details and any photos. Aaron or Alvin will follow up to discuss the work and a quote.

Can you do a one-time cleanup? +

Absolutely. One-time cleanups, leaf removal, hedge trimming and planting bed refreshes are all options.
